# Hippo

> > Hippo provides modern homeowners and condo insurance with smart home technology integration, serving markets across California, Florida, New Mexico, and beyond.

Hippo is an insurtech company offering HO-3 homeowners and HO-6 condo insurance policies with a focus on proactive home protection. The platform combines traditional property coverage with smart home technology recommendations and educational resources to help homeowners understand insurance requirements, policy types, and home maintenance best practices.

## Key Topics

- HO-3 homeowners insurance policy
- HO-6 condo insurance policy
- Replacement cost vs market value
- HOA and homeowners associations
- Mortgage insurance requirements
- Smart home technology integration
- Florida and California insurance markets
- DIC (Difference in Conditions) coverage
- Loss assessment coverage
- Property coverage types
- Home maintenance and protection
- Insurance exclusions and gaps
- Pre-closing insurance requirements
- Wildfire prevention and firescaping

## Insurance Policy Guides

- [Condo Insurance vs Homeowners Insurance [Deciding Factors]](https://www.hippo.com/learn-center/condo-insurance-vs-homeowners-insurance): Guide comparing HO-6 condo and HO-3 homeowners insurance policies
- [Getting Home Insurance Before Closing [Pre-Close Prep]](https://www.hippo.com/learn-center/getting-home-insurance-before-closing): Essential guide to securing HO-3 homeowners insurance before closing
- [Market Value vs Replacement Cost [Real Estate Insights]](https://www.hippo.com/blog/insurance-showdown-replacement-costs-vs-market-value): Insurance valuation guide explaining replacement cost vs market value
- [What Homeowners Insurance Doesn't Cover](https://www.hippo.com/blog/homeowners-insurance-doesnt-cover): 10 common homeowners insurance coverage exclusions and policy gaps
- [Do I Need to Buy Home Insurance Before a Mortgage?](https://www.hippo.com/blog/need-buy-homeowners-insurance-get-mortgage): Explains mortgage lender insurance requirements before closing

## Condo Insurance Resources

- [Expert Advice on Condo Insurance Policies in Florida](https://www.hippo.com/learn-center/condo-insurance-florida): Florida-specific HO-6 condo insurance requirements and coverage guide
- [Important Facts About Condo Insurance in California](https://www.hippo.com/learn-center/condo-insurance-california): California HO-6 condo insurance guide with HOA coverage requirements
- [Navigating Special Assessments in Condos [Proactive Measures]](https://www.hippo.com/learn-center/special-assessment-condo): Guide to HOA special assessments and HO-6 loss assessment coverage
